cause_quote: The new spawn selector called `const auth = decisions.evaluateNative(entry, host);` and immediately returned `unavailable` when `(profileId || auth.availabilityAuthoritative) && auth.availability === false`, before attempting to renew the observation.
user_saw: After another agent replaced the shared Codex client, a follow-up subagent spawn told the user to restore an account that was still signed in.
summary: The fix renews the native model catalog once after a readiness rejection and rechecks the selected model against the renewed catalog.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #150128: native subagent spawning and client-bound Codex readiness observations already existed, and a retired observation did not block spawn admission. #150128 wired both spawn paths through a new gate that treated the missing observation as authoritative unavailability. The fix PR verified the failure on a later baseline, while the pre-change behavior was checked through source inspection.
